chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
There is no harm in picking up lost items such as a staff, a strap, a peg, a rope, a hobble, and similar things.

key_terms.الشِّظَاظِ: a strap or small fastening piece
key_terms.الْعِقَالِ: a hobble or tether used for binding
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection; an expression of permissibility in legal context

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pick up minor lost items like a rope, peg, or staff in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that there is no problem in picking up certain minor lost items of the sort mentioned in the text. It relates to fiqh discussions on lost property and indicates permissibility regarding items like a staff, rope, peg, hobble, and similar objects.
